root: ^Fenlora: Käyro lies fallen… yet not slain. A worthy fight, soldier of the king. Long were you foretold, though your coming was swifter than we dared hope.
^I welcomed the fight. I only hope Käyro recovers.
^I came to aid your people, yet you greeted me with steel?

c-0: ^Fenlora: His spirit endures. In time, strength shall return to him.
^ He was our bulwark against the orcs of Drogo… yet a shadow has already slipped past.
^ The half-blood orc has breached our temple halls.
c-1: ^Lose Reputation On Complaining About Kayro Fight
^Fenlora: Forgive what seemed betrayal. In our need we awakened Käyro, for the tide of Drogo’s orcs surges toward us.
^ They covet the stone we guard.
^ Even now, one of their kind breaches our sacred place.

The_Orcs_Are_Here: ^Fenlora: Word of your struggle with him brought a hush to our fears… yet he hastens still, and the stone lies within his grasp.
^Fenlora: Walk beside me to the temple’s gate. We must not tarry, for should Balbino’s hand fall upon the stone, its song will break, and all its light be lost.
